description: RFC 9180 known-answer vectors for HPKE base mode with DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256 and AES (the Sync key-set sealing suite, vault-format.md C.1.4 and C.6). Only the sequence-0 encryption is kept: sealing is single-shot, so later sequence numbers add nothing.

provenance.source: CFRG HPKE test vectors, https://github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-hpke, file test-vectors.json at commit 5f503c5
provenance.obtained_from: the test-vectors-5f503c5.json file published inside the hpke 0.13.0 crate
provenance.extraction: entries with mode 0, kem_id 32, kdf_id 1 and aead_id 1 or 2; kept: the identifiers, info, the two key-derivation seeds, the four keys, enc and the sequence-0 encryption. The key-schedule intermediates (shared_secret, key_schedule_context, secret, key, base_nonce, exporter_secret), the exports and the later encryptions are dropped: nothing here uses them.
provenance.rfc_note: aead_id 1 is RFC 9180 Appendix A.1. RFC 9180 has no X25519 + AES-256-GCM appendix entry, so aead_id 2 (the suite Sync uses) comes from this file alone.
provenance.private_keys: skRm, skEm, ikmR and ikmE are published test keys, not secrets
